_comment: Squad Building Challenge rules: how the authored sbc.json vocabulary (requirement rules, reward entries) becomes the client's elgReq and awards contract.
_playerPickRewardNameComment: The award name FIFA shows for a reward pack that is a player pick (packs.json playerPickPacks): {rating} is the pick's minimum rating. Reward packs are named by id (packId) in sbc.json and the panel; the old pack-name mapping (rewardPacks, legacyRewardPacks, defaultRewardPack) was converted to ids at start-up and removed.
_repeatableRewardsComment: Owner rule (10-02): anything a repeatable set pays is untradeable (packs, players, manager league cards; coins and XP are not items). A hard repeatable set that paid tradeable rewards in retail opts out with "rewardsTradeable": true on the set in sbc.json. The live repeatable sets are the Bronze, Silver and Gold Upgrades, untradeable in retail; check retail before putting the repeatable UP_* and SP_* sets on the live SBC list.
_formationComment: Default formation for a challenge that authors none (sbc.json challenge formation, the retail one from FUTBIN, wins).
_bricksComment: Locked squad slots (the client's bricks). Captured EA responses put a playerRequirements entry per slot with playerType 'DEFAULT' (free), 'BRICK' (locked, empty) or 'CUSTOM_BRICK' (locked, a specific pre-placed player), and the squad carries 23 {index, itemData} entries; CardsDLL knows the challenge kinds OPEN_CHALLENGE / BRICK_CHALLENGE / CUSTOM_BRICK_CHALLENGE. Brick item ids live below the concept range (cards.json conceptItemIdBase) and never overlap owned items, so a save that echoes them back can be filtered by range.
_imagesComment: Set and challenge trophy art: imageIdBase plus the set id's offset from the first set id (900000). Set tiles are served from artFolder as <set id>.png, falling back to the set tab's tab-<tabId>.png (tab-<fallbackTabId> for unknown sets). The RARE rule is PLAYER_RARITY 1 (rareflag 1, the client label Player_Rarity_1 "Rare"): FIFA 21 names a PLAYER_RARITY_GROUP value as Player_Group_<n> (group 4 reads "UEFA Champions League") and never counts it, and its PLAYER_RARITY check matches rareflag exactly, so special cards are not rare players.
_requirementsComment: Requirement rule types. bound names the attribute holding the rule's number (min, max, or the quality name for value). eligibilityKey and scope are the client's SBCEligibilityKey and SCOPE names; a rule without eligibilityKey only appears in the description. A fixed eligibilityValue turns the bound into the player count. exact applies when the rule has an exact count between 1 and squadSize. {value} in a label is replaced by the rule's number, exact count or title-cased quality.

TOTW.label: Team of the Week players: Min {value}

_ignoredRequirementsComment: Requirement rule types dropped from every challenge: neither sent to the client nor checked on submit. CHEMISTRY is sent and checked: the server computes the squad's chemistry (chemistry.json) from the slots, formation and manager FIFA saves, plus the challenge's locked-slot cards, and never trusts the chemistry FIFA reports.
